searches.query: how to reference screen breakpoint values in custom CSS or change CSS variable at a breakpoint
Tailwind v4 exposes breakpoints as theme variables like --breakpoint-md. Use @media (width >= theme(--breakpoint-xl)) in CSS, or the --breakpoint-* variables with @variant md.
